system_metadata.description: Reporting and dashboard patterns focused on source validation and non-misleading outputs.

reporting_and_dashboard_design.purpose: Prevent charts from presenting stale, filtered, or invalid data as final results.
design_rules: show source period/refreshed status
avoid charts from raw unvalidated ranges
display slicers/filters or state them in note
ai_agent_review_steps: trace every visible number/chart to source or pivot
confirm refresh period and filters
verify no blocking quality gates fail
human_review_triggers: metric definition, target, or commentary requires business judgment
chart or KPI will be shared with executives
